entities.name: Sindhu battlefield
entities.summary: Theatre of Jayadratha's wars with the Pāṇḍavas.
entities.description: Theatre of Jayadratha's wars with the Pāṇḍavas. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Ahicchatra
entities.description: Northern Pañcāla capital. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Ayodhyā
entities.summary: Capital of the Ikṣvāku / Raghu kings; city of Rāma.
entities.description: Ayodhyā is the royal city of Daśaratha and Rāma in the Valmīki Rāmāyaṇa.

entities.name: Campā
entities.description: Campā is the Aṅga capital on the Gaṅgā.

entities.name: Dvārakā
entities.summary: Ocean capital of Kṛṣṇa and the Yādavas.
entities.description: Dvārakā is the fortified island city Kṛṣṇa establishes after leaving Mathurā; it is the Yadu capital until its submergence at the close of the Dvāpara age.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Kṛṣṇa's capital after Mathurā; later submerged in the Mausala narrative.

entities.name: Ekacakra
entities.description: Ekacakra is where Bhīma destroys the asura Baka.

entities.name: Gayā
entities.description: Sacred city of Magadha pilgrimage. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Hastināpura
entities.summary: Capital of the Kuru kingdom in the Mahābhārata.
entities.description: Hastināpura is the seat of the Kuru kings — Śaṃtanu, Dhṛtarāṣṭra and the court from which the epic war narrative unfolds.

seo.title: Hastināpura — Atlas
seo.description: Kuru capital on the Mahābhārata Atlas.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Capital of the Kurus; court of Dhṛtarāṣṭra and seat of the epic's political drama.

entities.name: Indraprastha
entities.summary: Capital raised by the Pāṇḍavas on the Khāṇḍava tract.
entities.description: Indraprastha is the splendid city the Pāṇḍavas build after receiving half the kingdom; Maya constructs its hall, and Yudhiṣṭhira's Rājasūya is celebrated here.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Pāṇḍava capital; Maya's hall and the Rājasūya of Yudhiṣṭhira.

entities.name: Kāmpilya
entities.description: Southern Pañcāla capital; Draupadī's city. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Kauśāmbī
entities.description: Kauśāmbī is the Vatsa capital on the Yamunā.

entities.name: Kuṇḍinapura
entities.description: Kuṇḍinapura is where Kṛṣṇa wins Rukmiṇī.

entities.name: Māhiṣmatī
entities.summary: Narmadā city of Kartavīrya / Haihaya fame.
entities.description: Narmadā city of Kartavīrya / Haihaya fame. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Mathurā
entities.summary: City of Kaṃsa and early seat of Kṛṣṇa's deeds.
entities.description: Mathurā on the Yamunā is where Vasudeva brings the infant Kṛṣṇa past Kaṃsa's prison, and where Kṛṣṇa later slays Kaṃsa before founding Dvārakā.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Kaṃsa's capital; scene of Kṛṣṇa's childhood return and Kaṃsa-vadha.

entities.name: Mithilā
entities.description: Capital of Videha. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Pāṭaliputra
entities.description: Pāṭaliputra at the Gaṅgā–Śoṇa confluence.

entities.name: Potana

entities.name: Rājagṛha

entities.name: Śākala

entities.name: Śrāvastī

entities.name: Śuktimatī
entities.description: Capital of Cedi. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Takṣaśilā
entities.description: Takṣaśilā is the capital of Gāndhāra, homeland of Gāndhārī and Śakuni.

entities.name: Ujjayinī
entities.description: Ujjayinī is the great city of Avanti on the Śiprā.

entities.name: Upaplavya
entities.description: Upaplavya is the Pāṇḍava seat of embassies before Kurukṣetra.

entities.name: Vaiśālī
entities.summary: Great city of the Vṛji confederacy.
entities.description: Great city of the Vṛji confederacy. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Vāraṇāvata
entities.description: At Vāraṇāvata the Pāṇḍavas are nearly burned in the house of lac.

entities.name: Virāṭanagara
entities.summary: Matsya capital of the thirteenth year.
entities.description: Matsya capital of the thirteenth year. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Dvaita Forest
entities.summary: Exile forest associated with the Pāṇḍavas and lake episodes.
entities.description: Dvaita-vana is another major forest of the Pāṇḍava exile narrative, paired with Kāmyaka in the wanderings of the Vana Parva.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Pāṇḍava exile forest of the Vana Parva.

entities.name: Dvaitavana margin
entities.summary: Southern margin of the exile forest belt.
entities.description: Southern margin of the exile forest belt. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Kāmyaka Forest
entities.summary: Forest refuge of the Pāṇḍavas during exile.
entities.description: Kāmyaka is one of the principal forests of the Pāṇḍava exile, visited alongside Dvaita and other hermitage landscapes of the Vana Parva.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Pāṇḍava exile forest in the Vana Parva.

entities.name: Khāṇḍava Forest
entities.description: Arjuna and Kṛṣṇa aid Agni in the Khāṇḍava fire.

entities.name: Naimiṣāraṇya
entities.summary: Sacred forest where sages hear the telling of the Mahābhārata.
entities.description: Naimiṣāraṇya is the hermitage forest where the Sūta recounts the Mahābhārata to assembled ṛṣis — the frame setting of the epic's narration.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Frame setting where the epic is recited to the sages.

entities.name: Nandana
entities.summary: Celestial grove named in epic geography.
entities.description: Celestial grove named in epic geography. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Aṅga
entities.summary: Eastern kingdom of Karṇa; capital Campā.
entities.description: Aṅga is granted to Karṇa; Campā stands on the Gaṅgā.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Gaṅgā / Campā.

entities.name: Aparānta
entities.description: Western coastal lands (Konkan). Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Aśmaka
entities.description: Aśmaka is the southern Mahājanapada of the Godāvarī valley.

entities.name: Avanti
entities.description: Avanti is the western realm of Ujjayinī on the Śiprā.

entities.summary: Northern kingdom allied to the Kurus.
entities.description: Northern kingdom allied to the Kurus. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.description: Southern coastal kingdom. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Daśārṇa

entities.name: Draviḍa

entities.summary: Northwestern kingdom of Gāndhārī and Śakuni.
entities.description: Gāndhāra is the homeland of Gāndhārī and her brother Śakuni, whose counsel shapes the dice game and the path to war.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Origin of Gāndhārī and Śakuni.

entities.name: Kaliṅga
entities.description: Famous eastern coastal kingdom. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Kāmboja

entities.summary: Ancient kingdom and sacred city on the Gaṅgā.
entities.description: Kāśī appears in marriage alliances and pilgrim geography of the Mahābhārata; it remains one of the great sacred cities of Bhārata.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Sacred Gaṅgā city referenced in epic marriage and pilgrimage lore.

entities.name: Kāśmīra
entities.description: Himalayan valley kingdom. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Kekaya
entities.description: Northwestern clan-kingdom in digvijaya lists. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Kerala
entities.description: Malabar coastal kingdom. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Kosala
entities.description: Kosala is tied to the Sarayū river in epic geography.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Sarayū river.

entities.name: Kukura
entities.description: Yadu-related western clan territory. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Kuru
entities.summary: Heartland of the Kauravas and Pāṇḍavas.
entities.description: The Kuru realm is the political centre of the Mahābhārata — Hastināpura, Indraprastha and Kurukṣetra.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Yamunā / Sarasvatī heartland.

entities.name: Madra
entities.description: Northwestern realm of Mādrī. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Magadha
entities.summary: Eastern kingdom of Jarāsandha at Girivraja.
entities.description: Magadha under Jarāsandha is a major power opposing Kṛṣṇa and the Yadus; Bhīma later slays Jarāsandha so Yudhiṣṭhira's Rājasūya may proceed.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Jarāsandha's capital; Bhīma's duel enables the Rājasūya.

entities.name: Mālava
entities.description: Malwa plateau kingdom near Avanti. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Malla
entities.description: Malla is counted among the sixteen great realms of northern Bhārata.

entities.name: Matsya heartland

entities.name: Oḍra
entities.description: Eastern coastal realm (Odisha tract). Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Pañcāla
entities.summary: Kingdom of Drupada; home of Draupadī and Dhṛṣṭadyumna.
entities.description: Pañcāla is the realm of King Drupada. Its court hosts Draupadī's svayaṃvara, binding the Pāṇḍavas to the Pañcāla alliance that shapes the war.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Drupada's realm; Draupadī's svayaṃvara and Pāṇḍava marriage alliance.

entities.name: Pāṇḍya
entities.description: Far-southern kingdom near the tip. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Prāgjyotiṣa

entities.name: Puṇḍra
entities.description: Eastern realm north of Vaṅga. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Sauvīra
entities.summary: Realm paired with Sindhu in epic lists.
entities.description: Realm paired with Sindhu in epic lists. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Sindhu
entities.description: Indus-side kingdom of Jayadratha. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Suhma
entities.summary: Eastern coastal kingdom in digvijaya lists.
entities.description: Eastern coastal kingdom in digvijaya lists. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Śūrasena
entities.description: Śūrasena is the Mathurā heartland of early Yadu history.

entities.name: Surāṣṭra
entities.description: Peninsula kingdom of western Bhārata. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Trigarta
entities.summary: Hill kingdom of Suśarmā; foe of Matsya.
entities.description: Hill kingdom of Suśarmā; foe of Matsya. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Vṛji
entities.description: Vṛji lies north of the Gaṅgā; Vaiśālī is its great city.

entities.name: Vaṅga
entities.summary: Eastern kingdom of the Bengal delta.
entities.description: Eastern kingdom of the Bengal delta. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Vatsa
entities.description: Vatsa is a Yamunā-side Mahājanapada with capital Kauśāmbī.

entities.name: Vidarbha
entities.description: Vidarbha is Rukmiṇī's homeland in the Bhāgavata.

entities.name: Videha
entities.description: East-Gangetic kingdom; Mithilā. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Virāṭa
entities.summary: Matsya kingdom where the Pāṇḍavas spend their year in disguise.
entities.description: The kingdom of Virāṭa (Matsya) is the setting of the Virāṭa Parva — the Pāṇḍavas' thirteenth year of exile in disguise, ending with the recovery of the Kaurava cattle raid.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Setting of the Pāṇḍavas' year of ajñātavāsa.

entities.name: Gandhamādana
entities.summary: Mountain of Bhīma's journeys and divine flora.
entities.description: Mountain of Bhīma's journeys and divine flora. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Govardhana
entities.summary: Hill lifted by Kṛṣṇa to shelter the cowherds from Indra's storm.
entities.description: Govardhana is the hill Kṛṣṇa raises on his little finger for seven days, ending Indra's pride and establishing Govardhana-pūjā among the Vraja folk.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Site of Govardhana-dhāraṇa in Bhāgavata 10.

entities.name: Meru
entities.summary: Cosmic mountain of northern sacred geography.
entities.description: Cosmic mountain of northern sacred geography. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Badarī
entities.description: Northern tīrtha of Nara–Nārāyaṇa fame. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Badarikāśrama
entities.summary: Himalayan āśrama of Nara-Nārāyaṇa; pilgrimage of the epic.
entities.description: Badarikāśrama in the high Himalaya is linked to Nara-Nārāyaṇa and appears among the great northern tīrthas visited in Mahābhārata pilgrimage lore.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Sacred Himalayan āśrama and northern tīrtha.

entities.name: Gokula
entities.summary: Cowherd settlement where Kṛṣṇa is raised by Nanda and Yaśodā.
entities.description: Gokula (with nearby Mahāvana) is the pastoral home of Nanda's clan where the infant Kṛṣṇa is brought after birth in Mathurā.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Nanda-Gopa's settlement; Kṛṣṇa's infancy.

entities.name: Gaṅgādvāra
entities.description: Gaṅgādvāra is the northern gate of the Gaṅgā.

entities.name: Hastināpura ghats
entities.description: Riverfront of the Kuru capital. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Kailāsa
entities.summary: Sacred northern mountain of divine geography.
entities.description: Sacred northern mountain of divine geography. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Kedāra
entities.summary: Himalayan tīrtha of Śiva fame in pilgrimage lists.
entities.description: Himalayan tīrtha of Śiva fame in pilgrimage lists. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Kurukṣetra
entities.summary: Battlefield of the Mahābhārata war and setting of the Bhagavad Gītā.
entities.description: Kurukṣetra is the sacred plain where the Kauravas and Pāṇḍavas fought. The Bhagavad Gītā opens with Arjuna's despondency on this field — Dharmakṣetra, Kurukṣetra.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Site of the eighteen-day war; the Gītā is spoken here between Kṛṣṇa and Arjuna.

entities.name: Laṅkā
entities.summary: Island realm south of the tip (epic geography).
entities.description: Island realm south of the tip (epic geography). Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Prabhāsa
entities.description: Prabhāsa is linked to the Mausala destruction of the Yadus.

entities.name: Prayāga
entities.description: Prayāga is the foremost saṅgama tīrtha of epic pilgrimage lists.

entities.name: Puṣkara
entities.summary: Great western tīrtha of pilgrimage lists.
entities.description: Great western tīrtha of pilgrimage lists. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Vṛndāvana
entities.summary: Forest grove of Kṛṣṇa's childhood līlās.
entities.description: Vṛndāvana is the pastoral landscape of Kṛṣṇa's cowherd years — rāsa, lifting of Govardhana, and the affection of the gopīs — celebrated in the Bhāgavata's tenth skandha.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Setting of Kṛṣṇa's youthful līlās in the Bhāgavata Purāṇa.

entities.name: Gaṅgā
entities.summary: Sacred river; mother of Bhīṣma in the epic genealogy.
entities.description: Gaṅgā is both goddess and river — mother of Bhīṣma by Śaṃtanu, and the purifying stream that defines much of northern sacred geography.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Mother of Bhīṣma; foremost sacred river of Bhārata.

entities.name: Godāvarī
entities.description: Godāvarī is the principal river of Aśmaka and the Deccan.

entities.name: Kāverī
entities.description: Great southern river. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Kṛṣṇā
entities.summary: Deccan river of southern digvijaya geography.
entities.description: Deccan river of southern digvijaya geography. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Narmadā
entities.description: Narmadā bounds northern and southern landscapes in epic geography.

entities.name: Sarasvatī
entities.summary: Sacred river of Kurukṣetra lore and Vedic memory.
entities.description: Sarasvatī is praised in Vedic and epic geography; near Kurukṣetra she figures in tīrtha lore associated with the field of the Kurus.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Sacred river tied to Kurukṣetra tīrtha geography.

entities.name: Sarayū
entities.summary: River of Kosala in epic geography.
entities.description: River of Kosala in epic geography. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Śiprā
entities.description: River of Ujjayinī. Placed approximately for educational atlas use.

entities.name: Sindhu
entities.summary: Great western river marking the edge of epic Bhārata.
entities.description: Sindhu is the mighty western river of Bhārata's geography, bounding northwestern kingdoms such as Gāndhāra in the epic world-map.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: Western river of epic Bhārata geography.

entities.name: Yamunā
entities.summary: River of Mathurā–Vṛndāvana and Kṛṣṇa's childhood landscape.
entities.description: Yamunā flows past Mathurā and Vraja; Kṛṣṇa's childhood narratives — Kāliya, boat crossings, and gopa play — unfold along her banks.

atlas.scripturalSignificance: River of Vraja and Mathurā in Kṛṣṇa-līlā.
